profile.reading: This is NASK S.A.s DC 11.11 data center at ul. 11 Listopada 23A in Warsaw, Poland, a facility whose name comes directly from its street address on 11 Listopada, meaning 11th of November street, itself named for Polands November 11 Independence Day. The facility carries a Tier 3 design and ISO 27001 certification, and NASK S.A. offers private and partial cabinet colocation, dedicated servers, and public cloud services from the site, though specific power capacity or floor area figures were not found in directory listings checked this session, and NASK S.A.s own site was not reachable to automated fetch during this research pass. NASK S.A. is a joint stock company, registered with approximately 78.1 million zloty in capital, established in October 2016 as the commercial and telecommunications arm operating alongside its parent, NASK, the Panstwowy Instytut Badawczy or State Research Institute. The parent NASK was founded in 1991 as Polands national research and academic computer network institute, and continues to manage the countrys .pl top level domain registry and .gov.pl government domains, and hosts CERT Polska, Polands computer emergency response team, distinguishing the state research institute from its NASK S.A. commercial subsidiary that operates this specific data center. The facility holds an active ANSI/TIA-942-B Constructed Facility Tier 3 certification issued by certification body EPI, certificate number TIA942PL231212002, dated December 12, 2023 and valid through December 11, 2026, confirming its Tier 3 design status through a recognized third party standard rather than only NASKs own marketing claims. NASK connected Poland to the internet for the first time in 1991 before becoming a formal research and development organization in December 1993, and beyond this DC 11.11 site the group is tracked in industry directories as operating two data centers in total alongside nine points of presence and four network fabrics, offering broadband internet access, corporate networking, data transmission, colocation, hosting, videoconferencing, and cybersecurity managed services under a workforce reported at fewer than 500 employees.
